20261103UT84790.description: Utah Amendment B. Requires 60% support from voters to pass new citizen-initiated tax increases.
20261103UT84790.summary: This proposed amendment to Utah's constitution would require 60% support from voters to approve new, higher or expanded taxes proposed through citizen initiative petitions.
20261103UT84790.seatName: B - Raise approval threshold for new or raised taxes

20261103UT84792.description: Utah Amendment A. Changes publication requirements for proposed constitutional amendments.
20261103UT84792.summary: This proposed amendment to Utah's constitution would require future proposed amendments to be published 60 days before an election in a manner provided by state law, instead of the existing requirement to be published in at least one newspaper in every county.
20261103UT84792.seatName: A - Require publication of amendments 60 days before the election
